Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Two Victories issue of 318-320, Reece period 16, chipped. Obverse description: Bust helmeted with low crest cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [?DN] CONSTAN[TIN]VS (---). Reverse description: Two Victories holding up shield inscribed VOT/PR over altar, diagonal lines on altar. Reverse inscription: [V]ICTORIAE LAETI [PRINC PERP]. Diameter:…
